theme.name: Complex fares system undermining trust
theme.claim: The fares system is complicated and hard to navigate, which damages passengers' trust in the railway.

text.line: We also recognise that the fares system is complicated and hard to navigate, and the impact this has on people’s trust in the railway.

theme.name: Historical origins of complexity
theme.claim: The complexity has built up over time, so undoing it will take time and must avoid significant costs for passengers or taxpayers.

text.line: The complexity of the current fares system has developed over time, and it will take time to undo this in a way that doesn’t carry significant costs for passengers or taxpayers.
